name: HIWF World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The promotion's top singles title, changing hands five times across 1998 including a masked-challenger swerve and a title-versus-title stripping.

name: HIWF United States Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: A singles title contested through 1998, twice changing hands by weapon-assisted or foreign-object finishes.

name: HIWF World Television Championship
epitaph: A gauntlet-contested singles title, changing hands repeatedly through 1998 and once decided by a sixteen-man single-elimination tournament after its own champion was stripped for holding two titles at once.

name: HIWF World Cruiserweight Championship
epitaph: A lighter-weight singles title contested through 1998, with one four-time champion by his own count.

name: HIWF World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: A tag team title held by The Predators through the summer of 1998 and, after an untracked gap, by the Insano Boys in the promotion's reopened 2001 run.

name: HIWF Intercontinental Championship
epitaph: Introduced in September 2001 as an eight-man single-elimination tournament to crown its first champion, still underway when this record ends.
